Day 001 — Setting Up Hugo Blog I just installed Hugo for the first time!
sudo dnf install hugo Why Hugo? Static site — no database, no server-side code Fast — built in Go, renders pages in milliseconds Free hosting — deploy to GitHub Pages for free Markdown-first — write in Obsidian, publish anywhere Themes — 300+ themes, minimal configuration What I’m Using Tool Purpose Hugo Static site generator PaperMod Clean, minimal theme GitHub Pages Free hosting Obsidian Writing notes in Markdown Next Steps Learn PaperMod configuration Set up Obsidian → Hugo workflow Write about ML fundamentals Apply for CityUHK IT Certification Sponsorship Stay tuned for more updates on my ML engineering journey!

Initially this project was developed by Youtuber Network Chuck in his video I started a blog…..in 2024 (why you should too). Watching his video inspired me to make my own version to further explore and expand upon the ideas presented.
Purpose Hopefully, this project will serve as a vital resource for me to facilitate the blog writing process and free me from my procrastination.
